verdict.rationale: Muse lets users link a named set of services (email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health/fitness data, finances) and can write custom connectors itself for services with APIs or CLIs, so adding integrations is supported. Nothing in the evidence describes a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps and connectors. Missing for 10: a browsable third-party app/connector directory, documentation of the connector catalog and the add flow, independent hands-on corroboration of adding connectors.
